rv.q: McCormick and his company have tapped into the contradictions of Carroll's masterpiece in an experience that extends beyond the fourth wall and five senses.
The lyrics connect to Carroll's story thematically, though sometimes obliquely, with a word or a sentiment.

cn.t: Critics praise this visually stunning, erotically charged reimagining of Alice in Wonderland as a sensory adventure blending burlesque, dance, and circus. Some find it overlong, but most celebrate the ensemble's astonishing talents and immersive spectacle.
